title: ORNL - Analysis of a Metallic Specimen
doc_notes: This document is an AARO-sponsored technical report by Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) analyzing the composition of a metallic specimen allegedly recovered from a 1947 UAP crash.

incidents.summary: Analysis of a metallic specimen claimed to be recovered from a 1947 UAP crash, investigated for potential inertial mass reduction properties.
incidents.explanation: ORNL analysis determined the material is terrestrial in origin and does not function as a terahertz waveguide.
incidents.quote: The material specimen, whose origin and purpose are of long and debated history, is claimed to be recovered from an unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) crash
